FROM ESS_APPLY_OT OT
JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE HR ON HR.PERSON_ID = OT.PERSON_ID WHERE OT.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND OT.PERSON_ID NOT LIKE '111111%' AND OT.ACTIVITY = '1' AND OT.BATCH_YN <> 2 AND EXISTS ( SELECT B1.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO IN ( SELECT HRD.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HRD WHERE HRD.MANAGER_EMP_ID = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO UNION SELECT AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO AND AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM HR_DEPARTMENT D WHERE D.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO AND D.ACTIVITY = 1 START WITH D.DEPTNO = #{deptNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} CONNECT BY PRIOR D.DEPTNO = D.PARENT_DEPT_NO )
AND ( UPPER(HR.EMPID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%' OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(HR.LOCAL_NAME)) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%' OR UPPER(HR.CHINESE_PINYIN) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%' )
AND OT.OT_TYPE_CODE = #{searchOtTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND GET_AR_SHIFTNO(OT.PERSON_ID, TO_CHAR(OT.APPLY_OT_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), OT.CPNY_ID) = #{shiftNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND OT.AFFIRM_FLAG = #{searchAffirmFlag, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND OT.APPLY_OT_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND OT.APPLY_OT_DATE < TO_DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
ORDER BY OT.APPLY_TIME DESC
